chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this hadith to elucidate the divine attribute of *al-Basir* (The All-Seeing), emphasizing that Allah’s perception is exclusively focused on goodness (*al-Khayr*), reflecting the Shia doctrine of divine benevolence and the absence of arbitrary evil in His sight. This concept reinforces the theological stance that while evil exists in creation, it is perceived by Allah as part of a greater good or wisdom, distinguishing His perfect knowledge from human limited perception. The narration serves as a cornerstone for understanding how divine decree (*Qadr*) is inherently tied to ultimate goodness, a key theme in Shia kalām.
